title: Wonder where that rat is by now
html_source: Bloom thinks of the grey rat scratching its way into Dignam’s grave.

anchor.text: Wonder where that rat is by now
anchor.prefix:
east, confessing: mea culpa. 

 Latin again. That holds them like birdlime. Priest with the communion corpus for those women. Chap in the mortuary, coffin or coffey, corpusnomine.
anchor.suffix:
. Scrape. 

 Tap. 

 They listened. Tankards and Miss Kennedy. George Lidwell, eyelid well expressive, fullbusted satin. Kernan. Si. 

 The sighing voice of sorrow sang. His sins.
